3 Stand-out Bullet Points:
•	Full-Time ICT Business Analyst
•	$80,000 p.a. plus superannuation 
•	Work in a professional environment.

Position Overview:
HYDAC Pty Ltd - HYDAC is a global provider of hydraulics, filtration and fluid technology solutions serving industrial sectors worldwide.
As an ICT Business Analyst at HYDAC Pty Ltd, you will be responsible for analysing business requirements and improving the digital systems that support engineering, sales, inventory, service and operational workflows. This position requires strong analytical thinking, stakeholder engagement and the ability to translate operational needs into practical ICT solutions.

Responsibilities and Tasks:

•	Work with users across engineering, sales, supply chain, service, finance and administration to formulate and document business and ICT requirements.
•	Identify, investigate and analyse business processes, procedures and work practices supporting HYDAC's hydraulic, filtration and fluid technology operations.
•	Identify system inefficiencies, deficiencies and limitations, and recommend improved business practices, system functionality and workflow behaviour.
•	Apply project management methodologies, principles and techniques to develop plans and assist with the costing, resourcing and delivery of ICT improvement projects.
•	Develop functional specifications for system developers, technology vendors and integration partners.
•	Use data and process modelling techniques to prepare clear system specifications for enterprise applications, reporting tools and system integrations.
•	Take responsibility for deploying functional solutions, including preparing and implementing system test plans to ensure acceptable quality, integrity and performance.
•	Create user guides, process documentation and training materials, and deliver training to employees using new or updated systems.
•	Act as a central reference point for ICT projects, providing guidance and information to support system proposals, priorities and decision-making.
•	Facilitate stakeholder workshops and interviews, maintain requirements traceability, and manage changes to agreed business and system requirements.
•	Coordinate system upgrades, integrations and releases with internal teams and external providers, supporting user acceptance testing, rollout and issue resolution.
•	Monitor post-implementation outcomes, analyse system performance and user feedback, and recommend continuous improvements to digital workflows and reporting.

Qualifications and Skills:

•	Relevant qualification.
•	Minimum 1 year experience as an ICT Business Analyst
•	Strong business process analysis, requirements gathering and documentation skills
•	Experience with process mapping, data modelling and functional specification development
•	Ability to analyse and improve enterprise systems, integrations and reporting workflows
•	Strong stakeholder communication, workshop facilitation, problem-solving and project coordination skills

Salary: The role offers a remuneration package of $80,000 p.a plus superannuation for a 38-hour work week.

result.description:
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented ICT Systems Test Engineer to join our team and play a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of our technology systems. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing and executing comprehensive test strategies, identifying defects, and working collaboratively with development and infrastructure teams to deliver robust, high-quality solutions. This role suits a methodical and analytical professional with a strong technical background in software and systems testing, a commitment to quality assurance best practices, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, agile environment.
## Key Responsibilities
- Specify, develop, and execute detailed test plans, test scripts, and test cases to validate the behaviour, functionality, and integrity of ICT systems across multiple platforms and environments.
- Identify, diagnose, and document functionality errors and faults in systems and programming code within established testing protocols, quality standards, and compliance guidelines to ensure systems perform to specification.
- Design and conduct regression, integration, performance, and user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure new and updated systems meet defined requirements and business needs.
- Utilise automated test software and frameworks to streamline testing processes, improve test coverage, and increase efficiency across the software development lifecycle.
- Produce clear and comprehensive defect reports, test summary reports, and related quality assurance documentation, ensuring traceability from requirements through to test outcomes.
- Perform systems architecture reviews and assessments, evaluating current and future hardware and software configurations, and contributing recommendations to inform strategic technical direction.
- Collaborate closely with software developers, business analysts, and project managers to clarify requirements, resolve defects, and support timely delivery of system releases.
- Create, review, and maintain technical documentation including procedural guides, operational manuals, instructional materials, technical specifications, and maintenance inventory records.
- Analyse test results and defect trends to identify recurring issues, recommend process improvements, and support continuous quality improvement initiatives across the organisation.
- Participate in agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives, contributing a quality assurance perspective throughout the development cycle.
- Assess risks associated with system changes and releases, providing input into risk mitigation strategies and supporting informed decision-making across project and operational teams.
- Support the evaluation, selection, and implementation of testing tools, methodologies, and frameworks to ensure the organisation's testing capabilities remain current and effective.
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- A bachelor's degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
- Demonstrated experience in ICT systems testing, quality assurance, or a closely related technical role, with a solid understanding of the software development and systems engineering lifecycle.
- Proficiency in writing and executing test plans, test cases, and test scripts across functional, non-functional, and regression testing scenarios.
- Hands-on experience with test automation tools and frameworks such as Selenium, Cypress, JUnit, TestNG, or comparable technologies.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose complex system faults and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Experience producing high-quality technical documentation, including test reports, defect logs, operational guides, and system specifications.
- Familiarity with agile and DevOps methodologies and the ability to integrate quality assurance activities into iterative development workflows.
- Solid understanding of systems architecture, network infrastructure, and software integration concepts relevant to enterprise ICT environments.
- Competency with defect tracking and test management tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps, Zephyr, or similar platforms.
- Excellent communication, collaboration, and organisational skills, with a strong commitment to delivering quality outcomes within agreed timeframes.
## Preferred Qualifications
- ISTQB certification (Foundation Level or above) or an equivalent recognised qualification in software testing or quality assurance.
- Experience working in regulated industries or environments with strict compliance, security, or governance requirements, such as government, finance, or healthcare.
- Exposure to performance and load testing tools such as Apache JMeter, LoadRunner, or Gatling.
- Familiarity with cybersecurity testing principles, including vulnerability assessments and secure coding practices.
- Experience with cloud-based environments and platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud, and an understanding of how they impact testing strategies.
- Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and associated tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or Bamboo.
- A postgraduate qualification or additional certifications in project management, IT governance, or related fields, such as ITIL or PRINCE2, would be highly regarded.
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative, inclusive, and forward-thinking team that values technical excellence and continuous improvement, where your contributions directly shape the quality of systems used across the organisation.
- Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including support for industry certifications, training programmes, and attendance at relevant conferences and events.
- Enjoy a flexible working environment with options for hybrid work arrangements, supporting a healthy work-life balance without compromising on career growth.
- Work on complex, large-scale ICT projects that offer genuine variety and the opportunity to deepen your expertise across diverse technologies and industries.
- Receive a competitive remuneration package with a clear pathway for career progression within a growing organisation that invests in its people.
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

result.description:
On behalf of our client, we are seeking a full-time experienced IT Network Support Administrator to manage and support our clients' network environment and day-to-day IT infrastructure. This role will play a key part in keeping systems running smoothly, resolving technical issues, and supporting the ongoing stability and security of the business’ network operations.
Key Responsibilities:

In this role, you will:
• Maintain and support the organisation’s network environment, including servers, routers, switches and associated systems
• Monitor system performance and respond to network or connectivity issues in a timely manner
• Troubleshoot faults and outages, identifying root causes and implementing practical solutions
• Manage user access, permissions and system configurations in line with internal policies
• Assist with system updates, upgrades and routine maintenance to ensure network security and reliability
• Keep accurate records of network configurations, assets and changes
• Work with external IT providers or vendors where required to support system improvements or issue resolution
• Provide support to internal users on network-related issues and assist with general IT queries

Qualifications, Skills & Experience
• A Bachelor’s degree or higher qualification in Information Technology, Computer Science or a related discipline; or
• At least 5 years' practical experience and/or relevant industry certifications demonstrating capability in network administration and support
• Proven experience in network administration, IT support, or a similar infrastructure-focused role
• Strong understanding of network environments, including configuration, maintenance and troubleshooting
• Experience supporting users and resolving system or connectivity issues
• Sound understanding of system security, access control and data protection practices
• Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate documentation
• Good organisational skills and the ability to manage competing tasks
• Clear communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues to non-technical users

Desirable
• Relevant certifications (e.g. Cisco, CompTIA, Microsoft or similar)
• Exposure to cloud-based or hybrid environments
• Experience working in a small-to-medium business IT environment or with external IT providers
 
Salary: $90,000 - $110,000 per annum (excluding superannuation)

result.description: Entelso  We are seeking a motivated  Telecommunications Network Engineer  to support the engineering, integration and optimisation of telecommunications networks across multiple projects in Australia.  This role involves supporting the planning, engineering implementation and monitoring of telecommunications network solutions, ensuring network performance and reliability while complying with Australian standards, regulatory requirements and industry best practices. The successful candidate will contribute to RF network design, system integration, network commissioning, testing and ongoing performance optimisation across multi-operator carrier and in-building environments.  The position supports to the engineering delivery of wireless network deployments involving major mobile operators such as Telstra, Optus and Vodafone, supporting integration, validation and technical documentation activities across indoor and macro network projects.   Benefits   Competitive salary aligned with skills and industry experience.  Opportunity to contribute to RF, DAS and wireless network projects across major Australian carrier environments (Telstra, Optus and Vodafone).  Exposure to interstate telecommunications deployments and multi-site engineering activities.  Ongoing professional development within a specialised telecommunications engineering team.    Task & responsibilities   Contribute to the integration, optimisation and performance monitoring of telecommunications network systems across RF and in-building wireless environments.  Support testing, commissioning and validation of 4G, 5G and legacy cellular technologies to ensure network performance targets are achieved.  Conduct RF performance analysis and contribute to troubleshooting activities under engineering supervision.  Prepare technical documentation, site records and engineering reports in line with Australian standards and project requirements.  Collaborate with project engineers, vendors and field technicians to maintain network reliability, compliance and service quality.  Participate in continuous improvement initiatives related to network performance and system optimisation.    Qualification & experience   Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications Engineering or related discipline.  3+ years of hands-on experience in telecommunications network engineering, including RF systems and in-building coverage environments.   Demonstrated application of telecommunications engineering principles including system integration, performance evaluation and network optimisation within carrier-grade environments.  Proven experience in telecommunications network engineering within RF and in-building environments.  Strong knowledge of LTE (4G), 5G NR and Wi-Fi, with understanding of legacy cellular technologies.  Experience with In-Building Coverage (IBC), repeater systems and Distributed Antenna Systems (DAS).  Experience using RF performance analysis and data collection tools such as TEMS, NEMO and GIS/RF planning tools (MapInfo, iBwave or similar).  Proficiency with RF test and measurement equipment, including spectrum analysers, RF scanners, RF signal generators, and cable and antenna testing equipment.  Demonstrated application of RF engineering principles including link budget calculations and system performance evaluation.  Ability to produce technical documentation using engineering design tools (Visio or similar).   About Company     Entelso Pty Ltd is an Australian telecommunications solutions provider specialising in network design, RF engineering and in-building coverage solutions across carrier and enterprise environments. We design and implement wireless connectivity solutions supporting major Australian mobile network operators including Telstra, Optus and Vodafone,   delivered through established supply chain partners.    The company provides nationwide delivery capability across telecommunications infrastructure projects, including Distributed Antenna Systems (DAS), repeater technologies and network optimisation solutions. Full job description 

We are seeking a highly skilled Solution Architect with proven expertise in Ezy-Serve, Change-Ezy SaaS and SAP solutions. The ideal candidate must have led end-to-end implementation of Ezy-Serve SaaS solution with integration to SAP S/4 HANA. Web Application, mobile application development, architecture, and deployment in Field Service Mobility Solutions. This role requires extensive customer engagement, technical solutioning, and ongoing support to ensure seamless adoption and optimization of the SaaS platform. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Architect, develop, and optimize the Ezy-Serve, Service Delivery platform and Ezy-Day mobile applications for iOS and Android. 

Own the full software lifecycle from conceptualization to go-live for Ezy-Serve mobility solutions. 

Drive the next-gen evolution of Ezy-Serve and Ezy-Day, enhancing performance, security, and scalability. 

Ensure seamless backend integration of Ezy-Day and the Ezy-Serve platform using RESTful services with SAP S/4 HANA, SAP GEF and integration with ESRI ArcGIS. 

Provide technical leadership to a team of developers, mentoring them on mobile app best practices. 

Drive implementation of SAP GEF on S/4 HANA integration with ESRI ArcGIS. 

Develop offline-capable mobile applications with advanced GIS integrations, including ESRI, SAP GEF, Mapbox, and OpenStreetMap. 

Act as a primary liaison for enterprise customers, ensuring successful implementation, troubleshooting, and support. 

Conduct customer engagement workshops to gather requirements, provide demonstrations, and ensure seamless onboarding of SaaS solutions. 

Collaborate with customer IT teams to align Ezy-Serve SaaS solutions with existing enterprise applications. 

Monitor and support customer deployments, ensuring high availability, proactive issue resolution, and continual improvements. 

Spearhead mobile app security using authentication, encryption, and data protection best practices. 

Manage the scalability and performance optimization of Ezy-Serve and mobility solutions for large enterprise customers. 

 

 

Mandatory Requirements: 

Hands-on experience in Ezy-Serve and Change-Ezy SaaS products, with multiple deployments. 

Proficiency in Android (Java), iOS (Swift), Angular WebApplication, and Restful Integration for enterprise field mobility applications. 

Strong experience in GIS mapping solutions within Ezy-Serve, S/4 HANA, Ezy-Day and ESRI ArcGIS. 

Expertise in Spring Boot, REST APIs, Kafka, PostgreSQL, and microservices architecture. 

Experience in customer support, implementation, and SaaS product maintenance. 

Proven track record of integrating mobile apps with ERP and enterprise systems. 

Experience leading cross-functional teams, including backend, frontend, and cloud engineers. 

Excellent customer relationship management and communication skills. 

Experience in IoT-driven FSM applications. 

Hands-on experience with SAP integrations for Ezy-Serve solutions. 

Strong knowledge of serverless architectures, AWS, and cloud-native technologies. 

Must have hands on experience in Ezy -Serve solutions and high-traffic FSM solutions with thousands of active users. 

This role is open only to candidates with experience working on Ezy-Serve. Candidates with experience in Ezy-Serve or Change-Ezy solutions are needed. 

Job Type: Full-time 

Pay: $75,000.00 – $90,000.00 per year 

Education: 

Bachelor Degree (mandatory) 

Experience: 

IT: 9+ years (Required) 

SAP integrations for Ezy-Serve solutions: 7+ years (Required)
